accepted_scope: finite element formulations and stated conventions
examples, result tables and current figures
stated maturity levels, limitations and exclusions
completed_recommendations: TET10 and contact figures use color-mapped filled fields.
Spring and concentrated-mass equations use native LaTeX.
Primary publication links, including Hammer-Stroud, are listed in the reference appendix.
The bounded composite V1 scope is included.
The shell_down, shell_middle and shell_up conventions are documented.
open_non_blocking_recommendations: Add stress and strain field maps to every demonstration where these quantities drive the mechanical conclusion.
Add convergence curves to studies currently documented mainly by terminal values.
Add an analytical or reproducible Code_Aster/CalculiX comparison for every claimed element-method pair where feasible.
Add synchronized QF_solver/reference result views where an external reference is available.
governance_note: This owner review accepts the document. It is not an independent review and does not by itself qualify an element, method or solver scope.
